findings.evidence: For X(u)=u^2 on R, opposite charts give the distinct constant +1 and -1 maps of S^0. Both have reduced degree zero but cannot be homotopic. Assert equal degrees rather than cross-chart homotopy. Batch 7 has corrected the current source; this finding records the exact pre-reader bytes observed.

The equality drops radial dependence of the normalized field. For X(u1,u2)=(u1,u2+u1^2), theta=2I and v=(1,0), the directions are proportional to (1,rho/2) and (1,rho). A zero-free radial homotopy is required. Batch 7 has supplied that homotopy in current source; this is a historical pre-byte finding.
